Data Loss & Interruption

  • Prevent Downtime: Ensure business continuity with express recovery and resilient infrastructure.
  • Protect Critical Data: Safeguard information across multiple clouds with scalable backup and granular restore from a single platform.
  • Preserve Trust: Mitigate reputational risk through proactive security and compliance controls.

Overexposed Data

  • Control Access: Gain visibility and enforce least-privilege access to sensitive data.
  • Enforce Policies: Automate policy reviews and ensure governance stays current.
  • Resolve Configuration Drift: Detect and remediate risky settings with proactive controls.

Digital Sprawl

  • Get Organized: From data, to apps, to modern digital workspaces and more – gain control of the full lifecycle from approvals, to creation, to retirement.
  • Improve Accessibility: Ensure the right people can find what they need securely and quickly.
  • Discover and Resolve ROT: Identify and clean up redundant, outdated, and trivial data to reduce risk and cost.
